meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装好后，Claude会读取相关权限和规则文档，按用户指定的时间范围（默认过去7天）查询会议，依次取得每个会议的纪要文档与链接，整理成按单日或多日的结构化报告；如果用户要求，还会将报告写入云文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间（如“这周”“今天”）的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 按本周范围生成会议纪要周报

say.text: 汇总上个月的所有会议记录
say.note: 上个月在单次查询范围内，可直接生成

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads permission and rules docs, queries meetings within the user-specified time range (default past 7 days), retrieves each meeting's notes and links, and organizes a structured report by day or multi-day; optionally writes the report to a cloud doc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to sort meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meeting content over a period (e.g., 'this week', 'today').

say_en.text: Help me summarize this week's meeting notes
say_en.note: Generates a weekly report for this week

say_en.text: Summarize all meetings from last month
say_en.note: Last month fits in one query range; runs directly
